[[File:Corrupted shards detail.png|100px|left]]
'''Corrupted shards''' are obtained from various activities in the [[Corrupted Gauntlet]], and are used to create most pieces of equipment within the [[minigame]]. They will be automatically placed into the inventory when dropped by monsters or resources.

They can be ground with a [[Pestle and mortar (The Gauntlet)|pestle and mortar]] to receive 10 [[corrupted dust]] each, which are an ingredient to create [[egniol potion]]s.
